evd_title: GPT-4 feedback overlapped 30.85% with individual human reviewers on Nature journals comparable to human-human overlap of 28.58%
finding: GPT-4 feedback overlapped 30.85% with individual human reviewers on Nature journals comparable to human-human overlap of 28.58%
P: 3,096 accepted papers, 15 Nature family journals, 8,745 human reviews (multidisciplinary); replication 1,709 ICLR papers
I: GPT-4 zero-shot single-pass 4-section feedback (~6,500 tokens); GPT-4 extract-then-match pipeline (match F1 0.824)
C: Individual human reviewers (human-human overlap controlled for comment count); shuffled-LLM null
O: Pairwise hit rate: GPT-4 vs human 30.85% vs human-human 28.58% (Nature); ICLR 39.23% vs 35.25%
S: Retrospective benchmark vs published human reviews
